ronherman.jp.finding: Terms prohibit unapproved reproduction, republication and secondary use, as well as use beyond the private-use scope. No written grant for 2D1 was found.
ronherman.jp.contact: Use the source site customer-support contact and ask for its image-rights contact.

us.alessi.com.scope: Exact US source domain only. Articles 13.1–13.2. Do not automatically apply these terms to alessi.com.
us.alessi.com.finding: The US site reserves image/content rights and requires prior specific written consent for reproducing, modifying or otherwise using its contents. No 2D1 grant was found.

craighill.co.finding: The terms require express written permission to reproduce or otherwise exploit portions of the service. No 2D1 image-republication grant was found.
craighill.co.contact: Use the source site contact and ask for its photo-rights contact.

www.muji.com/jp/.scope: Japan source paths only. Article 25. The Malaysian source paths are a separate unverified scope.
www.muji.com/jp/.finding: Japanese terms say product/person photographs and other site content belong to the company or other rightsholders; using the service does not confer an IP or publicity-rights license. No separate grant for 2D1 was found.
www.muji.com/jp/.contact: Use the Japan source site contact and request permission for the exact photos and proposed edits.

www.lego.com.scope: Exact source domain and US product source. Last modified 27 February 2026.
www.lego.com.finding: Public or commercial republication of website images requires written permission. The separate newsroom offers an editorial-only permission route, but current catalog photos were sourced from the product page; their eligibility and current modifications are not cleared.

www.stokke.com.scope: Official Stokke website copyright statement expressly addresses website contents used publicly or commercially. Regional/current application should be confirmed with Stokke.
www.stokke.com.finding: Stokke’s official statement reserves website/photo rights and requires prior written consent for public or commercial reproduction, modification or incorporation into another site. No consent for 2D1 was found.
www.stokke.com.contact: Request rights confirmation through the official Stokke press/contact route.

alessi.com.scope: Exact global source domain. Current page contains sale terms; the US IP clause was not present.
alessi.com.finding: No explicit republication/alteration license for the current photos was verified. The US sister-site clause is evidence of a rights concern, not proof that its contract governs these global-source files.
alessi.com.contact: Use the actual source site contact; ask Alessi/photo rightsholder to confirm this specific use.

flos.com.scope: Related US regional terms. Actual catalog photos are from /en/cy/ and /en/wo/; their corresponding terms are sale conditions, so US terms are not assumed to govern them.
flos.com.finding: The US terms require written permission for images and derivative uses. No photo publication grant was verified for the exact Cypriot/world source files currently in this collection.
flos.com.contact: Ask Flos or the credited photographer about the exact images and proposed cutout/crop treatment.

www.magisdesign.com.scope: Exact source company/download portal; a press portal also exists.
www.magisdesign.com.finding: Magis advertises freely available downloadable images and resources. A scoped license covering this studio’s publication, alterations, photographer credit and any commercial use was not verified. Download availability alone is not treated as clearance.

help.play.date.finding: The media-kit page offers photos and logos and gives a press contact. It does not state a full blanket license for the current studio/curation implementation, modifications or all third-party rights.

hay.presscloud.com.scope: Exact official HAY press-library source. The portal is JavaScript-driven and no detailed license text was available through this research.
hay.presscloud.com.finding: Official press-library provenance is recorded, but no explicit permission governing this site and its cutout/crop treatment was verified.
hay.presscloud.com.contact: Request image-use terms and exact photographer-credit requirements from HAY’s press team.

teenage.engineering.scope: Exact company press library, not an individual grant.
teenage.engineering.finding: The official press library provides image downloads and a press contact, but no full license was verified for current product-page assets, derivative treatment or this studio’s usage.

online.actus-interior.com.scope: Related ACTUS corporate/store policy. Exact online store terms were not successfully verified.
online.actus-interior.com.finding: ACTUS’s related site policy requires rightsholder permission beyond private/statutorily permitted uses. Exact policy applicability and a grant for these online-store photos remain unverified.
online.actus-interior.com.contact: Contact ACTUS/the credited photographer using the actual source URL.

www.beams.co.jp.scope: Exact main terms URL redirects to a JavaScript-only support page that did not expose substantive terms in the research tool.
www.beams.co.jp.finding: No usable image-republication grant was verified. Restrictive terms on BEAMS digroo and a campaign microsite are different scopes and are not substituted for the main store’s terms.
www.beams.co.jp.contact: Use BEAMS official support/press route for the exact store photos.

www.instagram.com.scope: A post or CDN download is provenance, not an independent license.
www.instagram.com.finding: The account owner, photographer and any third-party rights must be identified. No rehosting/modification grant was recorded; an Instagram link or downloadable image does not confirm permission.
www.instagram.com.contact: Contact the actual photographer/rightsholder after identifying them. No message has been sent.
